scripts.typecheck: npm run build:contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.build: npm run build:contracts && npm run build --workspace=backend && npm run build --workspace=frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n frontend,backend -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace=frontend" "npm run dev --workspace=backend"
